name: The Journey Has Just Begun
summary: In Orgrimmar, skilled leatherworkers learn how Onyxia's scales can guard against the black dragonflight. Overlord Runthak teaches them a rare cloak-making technique for the flames of Blackrock Spire.

sections.title: A Broodmother's Legacy
sections.body: Onyxia's fall is a triumph for the Horde, but the black dragonflight remains a threat. Her scaled hide resists draconic flame. So Horde leaders seek craftsmen who can turn the dragon's remains into defensive armor instead of letting them go to waste.

sections.title: Shield Against Shadow Flame
sections.body: Overlord Runthak teaches gifted leatherworkers to stitch the Onyxia Scale Cloak. His lesson is no mere show or mark of prestige. Deep within Blackrock Mountain, Onyxia's brother Nefarian breathes devastating fire. Without the enchanted protection of their broodmother's scales, any vanguard facing the Lord of Blackrock would be reduced to ash.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where are they located?
faq.answer: Overlord Runthak offers this in Orgrimmar. He recognizes Horde champions with master leatherworking expertise who aided in Onyxia's defeat.

faq.q: What requirement is needed to receive this quest?
faq.answer: Only skilled leatherworkers who have completed the aftermath of Onyxia's defeat can receive this, such as those who finished 'Victory for the Horde' or 'A Most Puzzling Circumstance'.
Overlord Runthak teaches leatherworkers to craft the Onyxia Scale Cloak from scales taken from the fallen broodmother.

faq.q: Why is the Onyxia Scale Cloak important?
faq.answer: The cloak shields its wearer from Nefarian's deadly, incendiary breath. Without its unique protection, facing the brood's master would prove fatal.

faq.q: Who is the Lord of Blackrock?
faq.answer: Nefarian is the Lord of Blackrock, a powerful black dragon and Onyxia's brother. He plots from the heights of Blackrock Mountain to dominate the mortal races.

faq.q: Why does the quest state that the journey has just begun?
faq.answer: Onyxia has been slain, but the broader war against the black dragonflight and Nefarian's schemes inside Blackrock Mountain has only escalated.

angles.text: For the Horde, protective gear forged from fallen enemies is vital to guarding its forces against further draconic devastation.
